x.description: Input activation tensor. Can be of any shape.

b.description: Bias vector, or `None` to disable. Must be a 1D tensor of the same type

dim.description: The dimension in `x` corresponding to the elements of `b`.

act.description: Name of the activation function to evaluate, or `"linear"` to disable.

alpha.description: Shape parameter for the activation function, or `None` to use the default.

gain.description: Scaling factor for the output tensor, or `None` to use default.

clamp.description: Clamp the output values to `[-clamp, +clamp]`, or `None` to disable

impl.description: Name of the implementation to use. Can be `"ref"` or `"cuda"` (default).

f.description: Low-pass filter for up/downsampling. Must be prepared beforehand by

padding.description: Padding with respect to the upsampled image. Can be a single number

groups.description: Split input channels into N groups (default: 1).

function.name: setup_filter
function.description: Convenience function to setup 2D FIR filter for `upfirdn2d()`.

f.description: Torch tensor, numpy array, or python list of the shape

normalize.description: Normalize the filter so that it retains the magnitude

gain.description: Overall scaling factor for signal magnitude (default: 1).

separable.description: Return a separable filter? (default: select automatically).

facebookresearch_icgan/stylegan2_ada_pyt.name: setup_filter
facebookresearch_icgan/stylegan2_ada_pyt.description: Convenience function to setup 2D FIR filter for `upfirdn2d()`.

function.name: upfirdn2d
function.description: Pad, upsample, filter, and downsample a batch of 2D images.

x.description: Float32/float64/float16 input tensor of the shape

f.description: Float32 FIR filter of the shape

up.description: Integer upsampling factor. Can be a single int or a list/tuple

down.description: Integer downsampling factor. Can be a single int or a list/tuple
